gaps: Every existing option found is an MCP server only -- none ship a standalone CLI binary usable from a shell, CI job, or non-MCP agent runtime.

None cover the full 70-endpoint dedicated surface (Suno's ~30 endpoints, Veo3.1, Runway/Aleph, Flux Kontext, 4o Image, Gemini Omni, per-model chat completions) alongside the 120+ model Market catalog in one tool.
None expose Kie.ai's async task pattern (create -> taskId -> poll/callback) as first-class CLI flags (--dry-run, --call-back-url, --agent JSON mode).
patterns: Kie.ai's own docs already ship machine-readable per-endpoint OpenAPI fragments (one per doc page) rather than one combined spec -- harvesting and merging those directly produced a far more accurate spec than prose-scraping the landing page.

The Market catalog's 120+ models share exactly two endpoints (createTask/recordInfo) differentiated only by a `model` field and a loosely-typed `input` object -- modeling this as one generic command pair (with a documented model catalog in docs/MODELS.md) is more honest than fabricating per-model schemas that Kie.ai itself doesn't strictly enforce.

novel_features.name: Unified Market Catalog Access
novel_features.description: Single create/query command pair that reaches all 120+ Kie.ai Market models (Seedream, Ideogram, Kling, Wan, Hailuo, PixVerse, ElevenLabs, and more) via a --model identifier and JSON --input, instead of one generated command per model.
novel_features.rationale: Kie.ai's own API funnels every Market model through the same two endpoints (POST /api/v1/jobs/createTask, GET /api/v1/jobs/recordInfo), differentiated only by a `model` field and a per-model `input` shape it does not strictly schema-enforce. Generating 120+ near-identical commands would have been mechanical but wrong -- it would bury the real command surface and force per-model schemas Kie.ai itself doesn't guarantee. Consolidating to one documented pair, backed by a generated catalog (docs/MODELS.md), matches the API's actual contract.
novel_features.example: kie kie-ai-jobs market-create-task --model google/nano-banana --input '{"prompt": "a corgi wearing a tiny wizard hat", "aspect_ratio": "1:1"}'
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents and scripts get one stable command to target any of the 120+ Market models present today or added later, rather than needing to discover and call a different generated command per model.
